name: Talent rows stay gated and choice nodes stay exclusive after points are removed (#5351, #3941, #5383)
contract: CharacterAdvancement.dbc gives every paid node a tree-investment gate: RequiredTabAEInvestment (byte 152) on the shared class tree is 0 for rows 0-3, 9 for rows 4-7 and 24 for rows 8-9, and RequiredTabTEInvestment (byte 156) on a specialization tree is 0, 8 and 23 for the same rows; the row is PositionY (byte 0x192). Paid nodes sharing a non-zero Group (field 29) sit on the same position and form one choice node. Venomancer (class 29) class tree: rows 0-3 hold Hive Instinct 7229 (804968), Envenomed Weapons 29607 (300855), Green Salve 7722 (800902), Playing With Poison 30482 (707563), Reinforced Shell 29588 (705966), Genesis 6117 (705962), Hallucinogenic Venom 7241 (560188), Weakening Venom 6116 (805778) and Spindlebind 7252 (800887); Chitinous Spikes 7237 (504406) is row 4; the row 6 choice node is Mamba Mentality 7244 (503976) or Celerity 30465 (804962), Group 111111; Shadra's Lair 7242 (804978) is row 9. #5351 and #3941 report that a player can path to a deep node and then remove the points above it, and #5383 that the last rows accept more than the tree allows. Expected: a gated node is refused until the rows above hold its gate, a point that a deeper node's gate needs cannot be removed, choosing the other option of a choice node replaces the first, and a layout that breaks a gate is refunded at login.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Try row 4 with no points above it
Row 4 needs 9 points in the rows above
SETUP: Spindlebind, the ninth point above row 4, is owned
Row 4 with 9 points above it
Chitinous Spikes is learned once the gate is met
Try to remove a point the row 4 gate needs
Hive Instinct stays: removing it would leave row 4 with 8 points above
Chitinous Spikes stays
Remove the row 4 node first
Then the row 0 point
Removing from the bottom up is allowed
Choose Mamba Mentality on the row 6 choice node
Mamba Mentality is learned
Both options of the choice node at once are refused
Drop Mamba Mentality to swap options
Choose Celerity on the same choice node
Celerity is learned
Celerity replaced Mamba Mentality
Try row 9 with 10 points above it
Row 9 needs 24 points in the rows above
Fixture: a saved layout holding row 9 with nothing above it
Fixture: a saved layout holding both options of a choice node
Log the character in again
The ungated row 9 node is refunded
The ungated row 6 choice is refunded
The other ungated row 6 choice is refunded
The valid row 0 node is kept
